Name: Pierre Marriage Mod (english Vers.)
Author: hyphennotation
Description:
[left]This is an English translation of Luo7710's Pierre Marriage Mod, their mod is required for this so  please make sure to download it!


[s]﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿INSTALLATION:[/s][s]
[/s][list]
[*][s]download the mod and its requirement's and unzip them into your mods folder.[/s]
[*][s]take the translation file and place it into the i18n file of the mod.[/s]
[*][s]and delete the ZH file that's already there and it should work![/s]
[/list][/left]if there's any issues or questions feel free to ask!


This mod includes:
[list]
[*]A new story about Pierre
[*]Completely rewrite Pierre's dialogue
[*]16 new events
[*]Discount the price of seeds
[*]Adjust 'Cash-back Rewards Program' rebate
[*]META description
[/list]

[b][size=4]﻿Installation[/size][/b] for fixed version

[list=1]
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29218]Pierre Marriage Mod[/url]﻿ and unzip them in Stardew Valley\Mods and put the image in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿.
[*]Download and unzip this translation file in Stardew Valley\Mods.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Configuration
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]﻿BetterExperience - Discounts in SeedShop, receives his seeds and so on.[size=1]It is on by default.[/size]
[*]YandereRoute - Dictates whether or not bad route will occur.[size=1]It is on by default.[/size]
[*][color=#f1f1f1]GlassesSprite - Changes the sprite with glasses or without glasses.[size=1]It is off by default.[/size][/color]
[*][color=#f1f1f1]TeenMode - Dictates whether or not the 11 hearts events which is for adult female will occur. [size=1]It is on by default.[/size][b]WARNING[/b]:Rape.[/color]
[/list]

[size=4][b]How To Trigger Events[/b]
[/size]
Pre-marriage events
[size=1]You should finish all these events to make him romanceable.[/size]

0 heart: [spoiler]Farm and Bustop.[/spoiler]
1 heart: [spoiler]SeedShop between 9:00 and 18:00.[/spoiler]
2 hearts: [spoiler]SeedShop between 9:00 and 18:00.[/spoiler]
3 hearts: [spoiler]SeedShop between 9:00 and 18:00 after entering sunroom.[/spoiler]
4 hearts: [spoiler]Bustop between 6:00 and 9:00.[/spoiler]
5 hearts: [spoiler]Has received Mysterious Man's letter, Saloon on Friday after 18:00, 
﻿ ﻿Has received Mysterious Man's 2nd and 3rd letter, back to Saloon.[/spoiler]
6 hearts: [spoiler]SeedShop.[/spoiler]
7 hearts: [spoiler]Mine.[/spoiler]
8 hearts: [spoiler]1.Seen 2 hearts event, 3 hearts event and Shane's 6 hearts event, Forest in the rain.
﻿ ﻿2.SeedShop.
﻿ ﻿3.Has received Mysterious Man's 4th letter, back to SeedShop.
﻿ ﻿4.Has received Pierre's letter, Mountain after 21:00.[/spoiler]
9 hearts: [spoiler]Seen 8 hearts event, has received Pierre's letter, Woods after 16:00.[/spoiler]
10 hearts: [spoiler]1.Seen all of the above events, SeedShop between 20:00 and 21:00.
﻿ ﻿  2.SeedShop between 18:00 and 19:00.
﻿ ﻿  3.Farm.[/spoiler]

[size=3]Branch Events

[spoiler]10 hearts: 4. Forest after 21:00.
If you are married to the six boys, you will go to bad route.
Otherwise,you will go to good route.[/spoiler][/size]

[size=3]Endings[/size]

-Good route:
[spoiler]12 hearts: Farm after 0:00.
13 hearts: Seen 12 hearts event, Farm after 0:00.
14 hearts: Farm after 21:00[/spoiler]

-Bad route:
[b]WARNING: [/b][b]Obsessive behavior, suicide, murder included[/b]
[size=1]This route can be turned off in the config.
[/size][spoiler]All the bad route events will happen in Farm in several days.
Bad ending: Select the first option at last.
Penitent ending: Select the second option at last.[/spoiler]
